title: Change windows
content:
# Change windows

| Change type | When | Approval |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Access ports (desk moves, VLAN changes) | Any time | None; log it |
| Access stack upgrade or reload | Tue or Thu, 22:00 to 02:00 | Team lead |
| Distribution switches | Sat, 06:00 to 08:00 | Change board |
| Core pair | Sat, 06:00 to 08:00, one switch per weekend | Change board |
| Emergency fix | Any time | On-call manager, by phone |

:icon[warning]: Always confirm the core pair is fully redundant (`show stackwise-virtual`) before touching either core switch.

Log every change in the [[Change log]].
